RECIPE CARD - AF-12 anti-rust alkyd enamel
Document: AF-12 anti-rust alkyd enamel
Revision: Rev 12, effective 19/02/2007.
Steps
1. Charge 520 kg long-oil alkyd resin AL-60 (Resine Altamira) into disperser D-2; agitator
300 rpm.
2. Add 180 kg zinc phosphate pigment ZP-40 (Fosfazinco Nord).
3. Add 0.2 kg soy lecithin with the pigment.
4. Add 0.8 kg ammonium chloride per 1000 kg batch, dissolved in 2 L water; stir 10 min.
5. 1 Nov - 31 Mar: add 1.5 kg bentonite anti-settling agent (winter dose).
6. Disperse at 1,400 rpm to fineness 6 Hegman minimum.
7. Cool batch below 40 °C before letdown. Record temperature on batch sheet.
8. Let down with 160 kg white spirit.
9. Add 4.5 kg cobalt drier flakes dissolved in xylene and 2 kg MEKO.
10. Rest batch 12 h in holding tank before QC sample.
11. Filter through 50 µm bag filter and fill 20 L tins on FL-2.
Change note
Pigment changed from CL-77 to ZP-40 (CM-2006-004, SQ-2007-002). All other steps
unchanged.
